title: No Egg Casserole
description: A hearty egg-free breakfast casserole loaded with sausage, hash browns, and a creamy cheddar cheese mixture. Perfect for feeding a crowd.
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup (10.75 oz)
30 oz package frozen hash browns, thawed
instructions: Brown sausage in a large skillet, breaking it into crumbles. Drain fat and let cool.
Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 9x13 baking dish.
In a large bowl, mix together shredded cheddar, cream of chicken soup, sour cream, French onion dip, garlic salt, and dry chopped onion.
Fold the thawed hash browns into the cheese mixture.
Spread half of the hash brown mixture into the prepared baking dish.
Sprinkle the browned sausage evenly over the layer.
Top with the remaining hash brown mixture and spread evenly.
Bake at 350°F for 1 hour until golden and bubbly.
